title: Identification of genetic biomarkers, drug targets and agents for respiratory diseases utilising integrated bioinformatics approaches.
authors: Ahmed, Fee Faysal; Das, Arnob Dip; Sumi, Mst Joynab; Islam, Md Zohurul; Rahman, Md Shahedur; Rashid, Md Harun; Alyami, Salem A; Alotaibi, Naif; Azad, A K M; Moni, Mohammad Ali
one_liner_zh: 该文利用生物信息学与分子对接/MD模拟识别呼吸疾病生物标志物及药物靶点，虽涉及TF蛋白与DNA调控，但核心是疾病诊断与药物重定位，非TF-DNA互作机制建模，方法可部分借鉴。
abstract: Respiratory diseases (RD) are significant public health burdens and malignant diseases worldwide. However, the RD-related biological information and interconnection still need to be better understood. Thus, this study aims to detect common differential genes and potential hub genes (HubGs), emphasizing their actions, signaling pathways, regulatory biomarkers for diagnosing RD and candidate drugs for treating RD. In this paper we used integrated bioinformatics approaches (such as, gene ontology (GO) and KEGG pathway enrichment analysis, molecular docking, molecular dynamic simulation and network-based molecular interaction analysis). We discovered 73 common DEGs (CDEGs) and ten HubGs (ATAD2B, PPP1CB, FOXO1, AKT3, BCR, PDE4D, ITGB1, PCBP2, CD44 and SMARCA2). Several significant functions and signaling pathways were strongly related to RD. We recognized six transcription factor (TF) proteins (FOXC1, GATA2, FOXL1, YY1, POU2F2 and HINFP) and five microRNAs (hsa-mir-218-5p, hsa-mir-335-5p, hsa-mir-16-5p, hsa-mir-106b-5p and hsa-mir-15b-5p) as the important transcription and post-transcription regulators of RD. Ten HubGs and six major TF proteins were considered drug-specific receptors. Their binding energy analysis study was carried out with the 63 drug agents detected from network analysis. Finally, the five complexes (the PDE4D-benzo[a]pyrene, SMARCA2-benzo[a]pyrene, HINFP-benzo[a]pyrene, CD44-ketotifen and ATAD2B-ponatinib) were selected for RD based on their strong binding affinity scores and stable performance as the most probable repurposable protein-drug complexes. We believe our findings will give readers, wet-lab scientists, and pharmaceuticals a thorough grasp of the biology behind RD.
abstract_zh: 呼吸系统疾病（RD）是全球范围内重大的公共卫生负担和恶性疾病。然而，与RD相关的生物学信息及其相互联系仍需更深入的理解。因此，本研究旨在检测常见的差异基因和潜在的核心基因（HubGs），重点探讨它们的作用、信号通路、用于诊断RD的调控生物标志物以及用于治疗RD的候选药物。在本文中，我们采用了综合生物信息学方法（如基因本体论（GO）和KEGG通路富集分析、分子对接、分子动力学模拟以及基于网络的分子相互作用分析）。我们发现了73个常见差异表达基因（CDEGs）和十个核心基因（ATAD2B、PPP1CB、FOXO1、AKT3、BCR、PDE4D、ITGB1、PCBP2、CD44和SMARCA2）。若干重要功能和信号通路与RD密切相关。我们识别出六个转录因子（TF）蛋白（FOXC1、GATA2、FOXL1、YY1、POU2F2和HINFP）和五个microRNA（hsa-mir-218-5p、hsa-mir-335-5p、hsa-mir-16-5p、hsa-mir-106b-5p和hsa-mir-15b-5p）作为RD的重要转录和转录后调控因子。十个核心基因和六个主要TF蛋白被视为药物特异性受体。我们对其与从网络分析中检测到的63种药物制剂进行了结合能分析研究。最后，基于强结合亲和力评分和稳定性能，选出了五个复合物（PDE4D-苯并[a]芘、SMARCA2-苯并[a]芘、HINFP-苯并[a]芘、CD44-酮替芬和ATAD2B-波纳替尼）作为最可能可重用的蛋白质-药物复合物用于RD。我们相信，我们的发现将为读者、湿实验室科学家和制药人员提供对RD背后生物学的全面理解。
